company.shortDescription: Humu is a human resource company that affects work through science and machine learning.
company.description:
Humu is a human resource company that leverages science and machine learning. Its technology builds applies the findings of decades of research to help anyone grow into a better leader, manager, or teammate.

The company was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Mountain View, California, United States.
